name: Moovicut
description: Free deterministic storyboard planning. No API key, no account, and no stored premises. Moovicut does not render video. The default board is 5 scenes of 3 seconds (15s). Pass shots, duration, or a scenes array for a custom board.

tools.name: plan_storyboard
tools.description: Plan a storyboard. Default 5 scenes × 3s. Optional scenes array for per-scene action, duration, camera, framing, lighting, and notes. Returns a compact payload and a /studio# link.

tools.name: export_prompts
tools.description: Return shot prompts for a premise or an existing board.
